labellingRules.positive: shared LEI (GLEIF-issued) or shared CIK (SEC-issued) stated independently by two publishers

labellingRules.hardNegative: the two records SHARE an identifier scheme and DISAGREE on its value (two different LEIs, or two different CIKs), AND their names actually collide. labellingRules.undetermined: a record asserting 2+ distinct LEIs names no single legal entity
labellingRules.forbidden: no label anywhere is created from name similarity; no name variant is manufactured; no model-generated label is used
labellingRules.jurisdictionIsNotALabel: the country a publisher states (Wikidata P17 -> P297, GLEIF entity.jurisdiction, EDGAR stateOfIncorporation) is a FEATURE field only. Agreement on it never creates a positive and disagreement never creates a negative.

leakageControl.splitUnit: subject (LEI or CIK), never the pair - a subject cannot appear on both sides
leakageControl.everySubjectIsHeldOut: This corpus has ONE partition. Nothing in it is ever fitted on.
